description: Before each weekly digest, turns your judgments, reasons and comments into charter proposals with evidence (weights, questions and queries to retire, new research questions, out-of-scope topics); an approved proposal becomes the next charter version.

enabled.description: Run the knowledge review before each digest.

windowDays.description: Days of judgments and comments the review looks at.

maxDirections.description: New research questions asked for per review.

minPromise.description: Jev's promise score a new question needs.

knowledge.finder.description: Finds leads for new research questions (method transfer, missing links, rising topics, …); judged by what its proposals bring.
